compressPdfJS.ghostscriptRequired:
Ghostscript is required to use the Compress PDF feature.
Please install Ghostscript on your system to continue:

• Windows: Download from https://www.ghostscript.com/
• macOS: Install using Homebrew: "brew install ghostscript"
• Linux: Install using your package manager
   - Ubuntu/Debian: "sudo apt install ghostscript"
   - Fedora: "sudo dnf install ghostscript"
   - Arch: "sudo pacman -S ghostscript"
Note: Most modern linux distros have ghostscript pre-installed. Checking command=> gs -v
